resources.string: Needs about 1.5 GB of free space (%1$s GB free now).
Banana Native makes the game\'s pack from your dump: it rewrites the game\'s code (a few minutes) and translates %1$s shaders (%2$s in the background, best on the charger). You can pause any time.
Start the game once on Banana Native first: its code is prepared then.

Builds the game\'s full shader set before play. This can reduce incomplete scenes while shaders are compiled. It takes a while and uses the CPU heavily; keep the phone charging. Shaders missing from the set are still built while you play.
The pack needs %1$s, and the phone has %2$s free.
